# Button Group

`content/button-group` &middot; content-level &middot; category: content

## Purpose

Two or three buttons, inline or stacked, each primary (filled) or secondary (outlined).

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `buttons` | buttons |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Buttons side by side.
- **stacked**: Buttons one under another. Sets `layout: stacked`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `layout` | one of `inline`, `stacked` | `"inline"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.primary"` |
| `color` | color | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `radius` | length | `"@theme.button.radius"` |
| `innerPadding` | spacing | `"@theme.button.innerPadding"` |
| `gap` | length | `"@spacing.sm"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.sm 0"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tables with square corners. Padding uses mso-padding-alt. | Fine. Inline buttons wrap when the column is narrow. | Buttons keep their own colors. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('content/button-group', {
  "buttons": [
    {
      "label": "Shop new arrivals",
      "href": "https://example.com/collections/new",
      "style": "primary"
    },
    {
      "label": "View the lookbook",
      "href": "https://example.com/pages/lookbook",
      "style": "secondary"
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "content/button-group",
  "data": {
    "buttons": [
      {
        "label": "Shop new arrivals",
        "href": "https://example.com/collections/new",
        "style": "primary"
      },
      {
        "label": "View the lookbook",
        "href": "https://example.com/pages/lookbook",
        "style": "secondary"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
